# Project Instructions

**THIS REPO IS IN HEAVY ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT**
There is **NO** production environment, nor any backwards compatability to account for.
**DO NOT** make decisions based upon some ill-concieved notion of "preserving past decisions", unless _explicitly_ asked to.

**Start simple and only add complexity as required.** Prefer the smallest design that meets the durable-conversion requirements; record decisions and revisit them when new evidence justifies change.

**Interface** as much as possible. Having the ability to swap in a different provider for something like speech generation, will be helpful. Plus, interfaces will make mocking tests easier.
